Valeriy Kuvshinov, doing business as Kuvshinov Software ("Company", "We", or "Us"), operates as an independent digital consultancy and development agency. Because we provide professional accessibility remediation services, we hold our own digital infrastructure to the highest standards of digital inclusivity. We act to the full extent of our technical capabilities to ensure our platform provides an equal, seamless experience for all web users, including individuals with visual, motor, or cognitive disabilities.

This statement applies strictly to the digital properties operating under the domain root at kuvware.com. As a fully distributed digital entity, the Company operates no physical commercial offices open to the public; consequently, physical access metrics are non-applicable to our operational scope.

The digital structure of this website has been engineered from the ground up - using native, semantic code to achieve functional alignment with the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA and AAA conformance.

We strictly oppose the use of automated "accessibility overlays" or temporary widget patches. Instead, inclusivity is built directly into the DOM, ensuring structural interoperability with native assistive technologies, including screen readers, refreshable braille displays, and alternative input hardware.
The core website architecture utilizes standard programmatic modifications alongside an integrated native accessibility menu, allowing users to execute real-time structural adaptations:
Strict hierarchical heading order (H1 — H6), correct ARIA 1.2 labeling, and semantic landmark segmentation (<main>, <nav>, <aside>) to facilitate fast screen reader index navigation.
Complete operational execution via standard keyboard loops, including custom focus traps on modals and highly visible focus indicators.
Accessible skip links placed at the absolute programmatic root level, allowing keyboard users to bypass layout directly to the main content or footer.
Visual text layers and active interactive components maintain an enhanced luminance contrast ratio matching or exceeding strict AAA (7:1) thresholds.

An isolated native accessibility interface allowing user-driven configuration changes, including system sans-serif overrides for dyslexia assistance, progressive scaling for text size, line-height modifications, and letter-spacing vectors.
Comprehensive system hooks to pause looping animations and CSS transition matrices, synchronized automatically with system-level hardware preferences (prefers-reduced-motion).
Users navigating our digital infrastructure may encounter specific structural boundaries dictated by external runtime layers and third-party ecosystems:

To protect against automated abuse, we utilize Cloudflare Turnstile. While Turnstile is designed to run invisibly and provide accessible fallbacks, strict browser privacy settings may occasionally force a visual challenge.

This website contains active links routing out to external ecosystems (including LinkedIn, GitHub, and client portfolio sites). These properties are maintained exclusively by their respective corporations or owners; consequently, their accessibility conformance levels remain entirely beyond our control.

We maintain an ongoing codebase remediation protocol to continually identify and update accessibility anomalies. If you experience digital barriers, layout errors, or require alternative data delivery formats while browsing this site, please file an inquiry via our official communication channel here.

Privacy Policy | Did Not Get It
Official statutory privacy disclosure and data processing protocol for the Did Not Get It browser extension.

This Privacy Policy governs the collection, processing, and protection of data by Valeriy Kuvshinov, doing business as Kuvshinov Software ("Company", "We", or "Us"), across our digital platform (kuvware.com) and associated applications, including the "Did Not Get It" browser extension (collectively, "the Services").

When you voluntarily submit a query via the platform's official Contact Form, we collect your provided name, email address, and the contents of your message. This constitutes Personal Identifiable Information (PII).

This data is collected for the sole, explicit purpose of customer service, technical support, and responding to your inquiry. The data is transmitted securely to our administrative inbox. We explicitly guarantee that your communication data is never sold, rented, or transferred to third-party marketing entities. Correspondence is retained for operational continuity unless you formally request its deletion.

To maintain operational stability and optimize the user experience, the website utilizes third-party analytics infrastructure, specifically Google Analytics. Subject to explicit consent granted via the platform's Cookie Banner, these services deploy standard tracking technologies ("Cookies") to aggregate non-identifiable usage metrics.

Aggregated data sets may include masked IP addresses, browser specifications, and structural navigation patterns. This data cannot be reverse-engineered to personally identify you. You retain the right to revoke consent unilaterally at any time by declining via the Cookie Banner or purging local browser storage and cookie caches pertaining to this domain.

In addition to third-party analytics, our core web server infrastructure temporarily logs standard transmission metrics—including IP addresses, user-agent strings, and request timestamps—solely for the purposes of security auditing, DDoS mitigation, and ensuring the technical stability of the Services. These infrastructure logs are routinely rotated and destroyed, and are never used for marketing or individual user profiling.

To protect the platform's infrastructure and communication forms from spam and automated abuse, we utilize Cloudflare Turnstile. This security service operates in the background to analyze network traffic patterns and authenticate human interactions without deploying invasive tracking cookies. Your interaction with our forms is subject to the Cloudflare Turnstile Privacy Addendum.
Cloudflare Turnstile Privacy Addendum (opens in a new tab)

During the provision of Remote Digital Assistance—such as guided form completion, navigational support, or CAPTCHA bypassing—we may transiently encounter highly sensitive personal, medical, or financial information (including credit card details or credentials).

We enforce a strict zero-retention policy for all live-session data. We do not record, log, store, cache, or transmit any sensitive user data encountered during these sessions. All assistance is provided ephemerally, and no persistent record of your private credentials or financial information is ever created or maintained by the Company.
5. "Did Not Get It" Extension: Data Minimization

The "Did Not Get It" browser extension operates entirely locally within your browser. Our core principle is absolute data minimization: your data belongs to you, stays on your device, and is never transmitted to our servers.
We do not track your browsing behavior, clicks, or extension usage.
We do not own, operate, or route your data through any external backend servers.
Your email content, sender addresses, and metadata are never copied, logged, or sent to the developer or any third party.
6. Extension: Google API Data Access (Limited Use)
In order to function, the Extension requests access to your Gmail account using the Google OAuth 2.0 protocol. We access and use this data in the following strictly limited ways:
The Extension reads the HTML text of incoming unread emails locally in your browser to check for standard job rejection phrasing.
If a rejection is detected, the Extension communicates directly with the Google Gmail API to apply your custom label and remove the "UNREAD" status from that specific thread.

"Did Not Get It" complies entirely with the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. We do not use your data to serve advertisements, we do not allow humans to read your data, and we do not sell or transfer your data.
Google API Services User Data Policy (opens in a new tab)

The Services may contain routing nodes and hyperlinks directing traffic to external digital ecosystems. Upon executing a redirection to an external domain, you are immediately subject to the privacy architecture of that third party. We exercise no administrative control over external properties and explicitly disclaim all liability for their data handling practices.
